title: S3 Upload Files

run.description: Upload file(s) to S3 from the local file system.

save_as.description: S3 file key(s) to upload as. Include directory in this path.

file.description: File or list of files to upload. Accepts strings or pathlib.Path objects.

endpoint_url.description: Override the S3 host for alternative S3 storage providers.

aws_access_key_id.description: Set the access key. Can also be set as an environment variable

aws_secret_access_key.description: Set the access secret. Can also be set as an environment variable

description: Upload file(s) to S3 from the local file system.
guidance:
### Recipe
```yaml
run:
  on_success:
    - s3.upload_files:
        bucket: s3-bucket
        file: example.csv
```

### Function
```python
from wrangles.connectors import s3
s3.upload_files.run(
      bucket='bucket',
      file = 'example.csv',
      key='key'
)
```
